system.notes: Chemical-delivery rifle with a selectable nozzle. STREAM mode: SMG ranges (as set here). SPRAY mode: treat as a shotgun with a fixed choke of 2 (SR2 p.95 spread patterns), with Power reduction applied to the chemical. Ammo 60 as printed in the stat line; the footnote says the DMSO gel reservoir "is good for 100 shots" — the book disagrees with itself, the stat line is used. A second clip holds the chemical; extra reservoir clips 20¥; the stock's CO₂ canister recharges for 50¥. May be drone-mounted; accepts top- and underbarrel accessories, not barrel. Legality is not printed in the catalog. Corporate Security Handbook p.68.
